channel.title: Secret Life of Boys
channel.desc: Ethan and Ginger finally start talking again, until Ginger admits to Ethan that she may be the reason that Penny dumped him! Matt, who is tied up thanks to Corey, does everything he can to get back to Tabitha. When he finds out that Tabitha and Corey plotted this together, he has no choice but to stick around and reconnect with his brothers. The first thing he plans on doing is helping Robbie face his fear and getting the family on the plane to Australia. Thankfully for Bob, it would also be the perfect gift for Corey.
